_meta.purpose: Normalized payout example. The source feed's <payout> element contains ESCAPED nested XML (<payoutInfo>...). This file shows the NORMALIZED JSON the UI consumes. The browser UI must NOT parse raw/escaped XML — a server-side API/parser decodes it (unescape -> parse <payoutInfo>) and emits structured rows like below. No payout data is lost in transformation.
_meta.note: Florida sample games in the feed have no <payout>; this real example is California Fantasy 5 (gameId 314), which does. FL result cards would carry normalizedPayoutRows only when the feed provides a <payout> for that draw.

sourcePayoutMeta.storedTimezone: UTC-in-payoutInfo (note: main feed draw fields use EST/America/New_York; payoutInfo timestamps are Z/UTC — normalize consistently)

notes: UI consumes normalizedPayoutRows + totals — NEVER the escaped <payout> XML string.
prize is numeric when a cash amount; null with prizeType 'freePlay' for non-cash prizes (e.g. 'Free Play'). Preserve the original label in prizeDisplay so no data is lost.
prizeDisplay is illustrative; final currency formatting should reuse the prize-formatting rule (05-doc R8 formatePrizeString).
Decoding is server-side only: unescape </> then parse <payoutInfo><winners> rows. Corresponds to game_result.payout_xml (04-doc).
Round-trip integrity required: every <winners> row (incl. 'Total Winners') must survive normalization.
